Asset Tag: PLTS-ASH-INV-01 Inverter Model: SMA SOLID-Q 50 Jumlah String: 10
✅
A — General Checklist
▼
NoCheck ItemCriteriaResultRemark
1 Make sure PTW (Permit to Work) already issued. —
2 Prepare tools & materials required. —
3 Clean outside of panel and cooler fan one by one using soft cloth. Cleanliness
4 Clean inside of inverter with soft cloth and blower (open transformer breaker and turn off inverter first). Cleanliness
5 Check all PV panel string connectors. Normal, no burned connector or open circuit
6 Record the latest Error LOG (Error Code & Date). No error, no alarm
7 Make sure all panel sealing is good. No dust/dirty, no sign of water ingress
8 Raise new WO & repair if any defect found. —
9 Leave the location within safe condition. —

Asset Tag: PLTS-ASH-INV-10 Inverter Model: SMA SOLID-Q 50 Jumlah String: 10
✅
A — General Checklist
▼
NoCheck ItemCriteriaResultRemark
1 Make sure PTW (Permit to Work) already issued. —
2 Prepare tools & materials required. —
3 Clean outside of panel and cooler fan one by one using soft cloth. Cleanliness
4 Clean inside of inverter with soft cloth and blower (open transformer breaker and turn off inverter first). Cleanliness
5 Check all PV panel string connectors. Normal, no burned connector or open circuit
6 Record the latest Error LOG (Error Code & Date). No error, no alarm
7 Make sure all panel sealing is good. No dust/dirty, no sign of water ingress
8 Raise new WO & repair if any defect found. —
9 Leave the location within safe condition. —
